name: Volume Single Scattering (Monte Carlo with Point Light)
definition: Computes single scattering radiance using Monte Carlo integration with uniform sampling along the ray distance, using a point light for background and emission.
summary: This method computes single scattering radiance in a participating medium by stochastically sampling interaction points along a view ray to estimate light transport from a point source, distinguishing itself from deterministic ray marching through variance reduction and noise.
